units.source_text: 我自幼體弱多病，常常休學一個月、兩個月，甚至曾因病在家臥床近一學年。

en.t: Ever since childhood I was frail and often ill, frequently missing school for a month or two at a time, and once even staying in bed at home with sickness for nearly an entire school year.

units.source_text: 儘管這樣，我還是拖著大病初癒的身子，搭乘人力車去學校參加期末考試，而且比班上所有的同學都考得好。

en.t: Even so, I dragged my body, barely recovered from a serious illness, rode a rickshaw to school to take the final examination, and did better than every other student in the class.

units.source_text: 即使在身體狀態好的時候，我也毫不用功，去了學校，也只是不停地在課堂上畫漫畫，下課休息時拿給同學們看，講給他們聽，逗大家笑。

en.t: Even when I was in good health, I never studied at all; at school I only kept drawing cartoons during class, then showed them to my classmates during breaks, explained them, and made everyone laugh.

units.source_text: 作文課上，我總是寫一些滑稽的故事，就算被老師警告，也照寫不誤。

en.t: In composition class, I always wrote comic stories, and even when the teacher warned me, I went right on writing them.

units.source_text: 因為我知道，老師正悄悄地以閱讀我寫的滑稽故事為樂呢。

en.t: That was because I knew the teacher was secretly enjoying reading the comic stories I wrote.
